title: Croatian Lamb Skewers with Herby Marinade
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb skewer recipe, inspired by Croatian cuisine. The herby marinade adds a bright and refreshing twist to traditional lamb dishes.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and black pepper to create the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with remaining marinade and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh rosemary and lemon wedges on the side.
